titulo: The future and future perfect to express surprise or rejection
subtitulo: ¡No serás capaz! ¡No te lo habrás comido tú!
regla: In exclamations, the simple future expresses surprise, disapproval or suspicion about the present or near future: ¡No serás capaz! ¡Será posible! The future perfect does it about the past: ¡No habrás sido capaz! ¡No lo habrás tomado tú!

lista.texto: **¡No serás capaz!** (_You wouldn't dare!_) **¿Será posible?** (_Can you believe it?_)
**¡No habrás sido capaz!** (_You didn't!_) **¡No lo habrás tomado tú!** (_Don't tell me you took it!_)

bloques.texto: Not a real future; it's an attitude: disbelief, disapproval, suspicion.
Common fixed lines: **¡Será posible!**, **¿Qué te habrás creído?** (_Who do you think you are?_)
Tip: the future here raises an eyebrow, it doesn't predict.

lista.es: —Voy a ir a una playa nudista. —¡No ==serás== capaz!
lista.en: —I'm going to a nudist beach. —You wouldn't dare!

lista.es: Ese señor me empujó al pasar. ¡==Será== grosero!
lista.en: That man pushed me as he went by. How rude can you be!

lista.es: —Ayer puse la maleta de mi novio en la calle. —¡No ==habrás sido== capaz!
lista.en: —Yesterday I put my boyfriend's suitcase out on the street. —You didn't!

lista.es: Me faltan 200 pesos. ¡No los ==habrás agarrado== tú!
lista.en: I'm missing 200 pesos. Don't tell me you took them!
Who do you think you are?

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: React: _—Me voy a tatuar la cara._ (You wouldn't dare!)
Fixed line: _Who do you think you are?_
